def to_poly(shp, tol):
    verts, tris = shp.tessellate(tol)
    v = np.array([(p.X,p.Y,p.Z) for p in verts])
    f = np.hstack([np.full((len(tris),1),3), np.array(tris, dtype=np.int64)])
